title: RequestClassification
description: Custom structured output returned by the Agent node in the Power Automate flow built in Lab 19. Paste the properties below into the Agent node's Output > Custom structured output editor.

category.description: The kind of request the customer message represents. Choose exactly one.

urgency.description: How quickly a human must respond. High means the customer is distressed, an animal's welfare is mentioned, or a same-day deadline is stated. Low means a general enquiry with no deadline.

draftReply.description: A polite reply of 40 to 120 words addressed to the customer, in British English, signed off as the Pet Boarding team. Never promise a refund or a discount; never invent a booking reference.
